name: Promimic AB (publ)
summary: Promimic AB (publ) is dedicated to developing, commercializing, and supplying specialized biomaterials designed to enhance the integration of bone with orthopedic and dental implants. A core offering is its proprietary HAnano surface technology, an innovative solution that integrates a range of characteristics known to significantly optimize bone-to-implant bonding into a single, distinct surface modification. Established in 2004, the company's operations are headquartered in Mölndal, Sweden.
